name: Fish
desc: A pattern caught and brought into realspace. Right-click to box it with others of its species; control-right-click to box all loose fish of that species aboard.

name: Catch Bundle
desc: Fish of one species, boxed together. Right-click to unpack them; control-right-click to combine all fish aboard into one pile.

name: Catch Pile
desc: A collection of fish in one cargo stack. Packing them does not change their value. Right-click to unpack: single specimens stay loose, repeated species go into boxes.

name: Compass
desc: A hand compass in a dented brass case. The engraving on the lid has been rubbed almost smooth.
